title: Why do leaves change colour?
examples: Teacher, why does the leaf turn red?
Does the tree get sick when the leaves change colour?
What happens to the leaves in the fall?

explain.say: Look at the leaf. It is green now.

draw.text: Leaves are green because of chlorophyll.

explain.say: Leaves have a green stuff called chlorophyll. It helps the leaf make food from sunlight.

draw.text: Chlorophyll makes food for the leaf.

explain.say: In autumn, the days get shorter and cooler. The leaf stops making chlorophyll.
As the green fades, yellow and orange colours show through. Some leaves make new red colours too.

draw.text: Yellow, orange and red colours show through.

explain.say: In autumn, the tree gets ready for winter. It saves its energy.

draw.text: Tree saves energy for winter sleep.

explain.say: Think about a crunchy autumn leaf on the ground.

faq.q: Why do leaves change colour in autumn?
faq.a: The change happens because the leaf stops making the green stuff called chlorophyll.
asks: What makes the leaves change colour?
Do leaves change colour because it is cold?

faq.q: Is the colour change because of the cold weather?
faq.a: Shorter days and cooler weather tell the tree to get ready for winter.
asks: Is it the cold that makes the leaves fall?
Why does the season change the leaves?

faq.q: Are the yellow and red colours always there?
faq.a: The yellow and orange colours are there all along, hidden by the green. Red colours are made new in autumn.
asks: Why do we only see the colours in autumn?

faq.q: Do the leaves fall off the tree?
faq.a: Yes, the tree lets the leaves go so they do not lose too much energy in the cold.
asks: Do the trees shed their leaves?
What happens to the leaves when they fall?

faq.a: Chlorophyll is the green substance that helps the leaf make its own food using sunlight.
asks: What does chlorophyll do for the plant?

facts: Chlorophyll is the pigment that makes leaves look green.
Yellow and orange colours are already in the leaf. Red colours are made in autumn.
As autumn approaches, the tree reduces chlorophyll production.
This process helps the tree save energy for the winter.

quiz.why: Chlorophyll is the green stuff in leaves.

wrong.0: Cold air comes in autumn, when leaves lose their green.
wrong.2: Rain helps plants grow, but it gives no colour.

quiz.say: The green fades in autumn. Which colours show through?
quiz.why: Yellow and orange were hiding under the green all along.

wrong.0: Leaves turn warm colours in autumn, not white and grey.
wrong.1: Leaves turn warm colours in autumn, like yellow and orange.

quiz.say: Why does a tree stop making chlorophyll in autumn?
quiz.why: Getting ready for winter helps the tree save its energy.

wrong.1: This happens to healthy trees every autumn.
